listing_info.listing_name: Gram's House
listing_info.description:
Enjoy easy access to town from this historic home. Relax on the deck overlooking Wolfeboro Bay. Enjoy a swim whenever you want.

There are 4-season activities in the area: bike, hiking and ski trails close by.

Private beach, raft (no dock), canoe/kayaks, and beach toys.

Great gathering place: our family has enjoyed many special events here!

HOWEVER, if you are looking for a place to have loud parties, this is not for you. This rental is in a neighborhood and we respect our neighbors.

The space
There is a well-equipped kitchen, formal dining room, and great room overlooking Lake Winnipesaukee. This great room opens onto a spacious deck. The first floor also has a bathroom with stall shower and an event room.

The second floor has a king suite with a privacy door and its own full bathroom.

There are 3 other bedrooms on the 2nd floor: one room with a queen, one with a set of twins and the final second floor bedroom has a set of twins that can be made into a queen bed. There is a 1/2 and a full bath with a tub also on the second floor.

So sorry but we do not allow pets on the property.

There are 2 parking spots in the garage spring through late fall and one parking space in the garage in the winter. Lots of creative ways to park other cars between the garage and the street and in the driveway.

Guest access
You can use all of the rooms though occasionally the library is off limits.

Other things to note
There are plenty of linens & towels. There is no AC but you will enjoy lovely breezes off the lake. We also have ceiling & portable fans to keep you cool.

listing_info.listing_name: Spacious, Dog Friendly Rental in Wolfeboro NH!
listing_info.description:
Four-bedrooms, and dog friendly! Rust Pond water access at the very end of the property. Close to Gunstock Ski Mountain and King Pine Skiing. Less than an hour to ski Mount Cranmore. Access to the snowmobile trails, ice fishing. Downtown Wolfeboro one mile away to shop! Two bedrooms, 2 decks, living room & kitchen with all your amenities, One King bed and 3 Queen beds. Enjoy outdoor fire pits, and a very large yard, also a beautiful full-service restaurant located on premise, called Trenta.

The space
The condo is upstairs above our newly open restaurant, Trenta, and has stair access only. Upon your stay, you will have access to the entire four-bedroom condo and what it has to offer...

Guest access
The whole Inn

Other things to note
House Rules:
-No Smoking
-No parties or events
- All beds must be stripped down and items put into the laundry basket in the designated room this includes towels, sheets, fitted sheets, and pillowcases. Please fold the comforter and place it next to the laundry basket
- Patio chairs need to be brought inside upon departure.
-Enjoy!

listing_info.listing_name: Luxury Lakehouse| Sunsets| Cen. Air| Private Dock
listing_info.description:
Crystal clear Rust Pond contemporary waterfront home with picturesque lake views from every angle and multiple decks. Your vacation home has central AC for hot days and a cozy gas fireplace and central heat for chilly nights. Rust Pond is an oligotrophic lake with excellent swimming, SUP boarding, kayaking, fishing, etc. The home offers privacy in a peaceful lakeside setting, yet is just 10 mins from Wolfeboro downtown restaurants, farm to table fare, art galleries and boutique shopping.

The space
The house is freshly remodeled: light, airy, modern and beautiful with vaulted ceilings, large windows overlooking the lake from just about every room and streams of natural lighting. Your lakefront home away from home has been stylishly redesigned with high end furnishings and artistic touches for your iconic NH getaway.

We have 4 decks, all with water views:
1st right off the kitchen with a dinning table and chairs
2nd right in front of the living room with 4 lounger chairs
3rd right in front of the lower level
4th is a stand alone deck right over the stairs with a sectional seating arrangement and large umbrella for sunny days

Cleanliness is a top priority, and so we ask all guests to leave their shoes at the door. You can bring your home shoes if you feel more comfortable.

The living area features long, light filled windows overlooking the magnificent lake, plush leather sofa, and 2 comfy swivel egg chairs. There is a West Elm double chaise to relax, read and take in the view. Wifi available through out the property including the decks. We also have central air and heat to keep you comfortable throughout the stay. The lake house has lots of board games and books for all ages.

Throughout the house we have Casper mattresses for the most comfortable sleep during your stay. On the main floor are 2 bedrooms and a full bath. The second floor is an open loft overlooking the lake with a master en suite. The walkout lower level has an office with a Joybird Eliot Sleeper Sectional that pulls out into a queen foam mattress bed and its own private full bathroom. The house comfortably accommodates six (6) people.

We have 2 Bedrooms, 1 loft, one lower level room that can serve as bedroom or office and 3 full bathrooms:
(1) Master bedroom with King-Sized Bed, full bathroom and majestic views of water from the Loft. The loft overlooks the windows facing the water and there is no door to this room.
(2) A bedroom with bunk beds - full and twin
(3) A bedroom with 2 full size beds
(4) Lower level room with Joybird Eliot Sleeper Sectional that pulls our into a queen foam mattress bed and panoramic views of the lake. There is a full bathroom accessible from the lower level room.
Please Note: We provide enough pillows, blankets, comforters, linens and bath/hand/face/kitchen towels. Guests just have to bring their own beach towels.

A Chefs Kitchen ~ fully equipped with custom cabinets, granite countertops stainless steel appliances including a gas range, microwave, fridge/freezer, dishwasher, coffee maker, toaster, blender, cookware, dish ware, and flatware. Tea, coffee, basic spices and condiments included ~ we hope you enjoy!

Large Dock with water toys ~ 30x6 brand new dock with wide staircase to easily get to the water. In the summer your family can enjoy cooling off in the lake: kayaking, paddle boarding, and swimming. We provide outdoor toys for your enjoyment: 2 stand-up paddle boards, 1 kid kayak, 1 single adult kayak, 2 person inflatable kayak and a floating rubber dockie mat. Rust pond has some great fishing, which you can enjoy right from the dock. Plenty of life jackets available and recommended when using water toys.

Fire pit ~ We have a large patio overlooking the lake with an outdoor firepit to roast marshmallows and enjoy the lake. It is our favorite place to hangout when there is a little chill in the air.

ATTRACTIONS:
Wright Museum of World War II (4 mi), Castle in the Clouds - Lucknow Mansion (20 mi), North Conway Shopping Outlets (50 mi), Storyland Childrens Amusement Park (50 mi), Santa's Village in Jefferson, NH (92 mi), Journey to the North Pole in Conway, NH (45 mi)

RESTAURANTS - DOWNTOWN WOLFEBORO
Marker 21, El Centenario, Seven Suns Cafe, Garwoods, Nolans Brick Oven Pizzeria, Wolfeboro Dockside Grill and Dairy Bar, Bayside Grill and Tavern

BREWERIES AND WINERIES
Lone Wolfe Brewing Company (4 mi), Gilmanton Winery and Restaurant (26 mi)

HIKING:
Brewster Heath Preserve Walking Trail (2 mi), Sewall Woods (5mi), Mt Major ( 14.5 mi), Plummer's Ridge Forest & Farm Hiking Trails (17 mi), Castle in the Clouds (20 mi)

SKI RESORTS:
Wolfeboro Abenaki Ski Area(6 mi), Gunstock Mountain Resort(22 mi), Cranmore Ski Resort(45 mi), Attitash Resort(52 mi), Ragged Mountain Resort(55 mi)

CROSS COUNTRY SKIING/SNOWSHOEING:
Sewall Woods (5mi)
Nordic Skier Sports (for full ski and snow shoe rentals) (4mi)

GOLFING:
Kingswood Golf Club (2 mi), Lake Winnipesaukee Gold Club (6 mi), Farmington Country Club (21 mi)

WATER ACTIVITIES:
Wake Winni (2 mi), US Postal Service Delivery Boat (2 mi), Mt Washington Boat Cruise (2 mi), Goodhue Boat Rental (5 mi)

Every season on Rust pond has its own charm.

SUMMER:

You can also rent a boat at Goodhue boat rental (5 mi), to go tubing on Lake Winnipesaukee. Wake Winni water sports (3mi), has excellent wake surfing, water skiing and wake boarding lessons. Our kids learned how to water ski and wake board with Wake Winni! From the town docks (3 mi) you can also jump on the US Postal Service delivery boat and cruise around the lake delivering mail. Kids can help deliver the US Postal mail to all the islands in Winnipesaukee. (This is a favorite for our kids!) This is the best way to explore the entirety of the lake with the family.

FALL:
Autumn brings a crispness to the air and beautiful views of the fall foliage. There are great hiking trails close by, including Mt Major 14.5mi, Brewster Heath Preserve Walking Trail (2mi). We also have an outdoor fire pit to roast marshmallows and enjoy the lake.

WINTER:
In winter the lake freezes over, providing opportunities to explore the lake like never before - walking, snowshoeing, skating, or cross country skiing. Sewall woods (5mi) provides miles of groomed cross country skiing trails and snowshoeing paths. Nordic Skier Sports (4mi) provides the rentals and trail pass you need to enjoy a day out snowshoeing or cross country skiing. We are also (6mi) from Abenaki, (20mi) from Gunstock & (29mi) from Kingpine for skiing, snowboarding and snowtubing fun! Once back home snuggle up with a hot chocolate next to the gas stove and admire the views.

SPRING:
There are lots of great hikes in the area. Castle in the Clouds, Mt Major 14.5mi, Brewster Heath Preserve Walking Trail (2mi) are some of our favorites. You can also bring your bikes and enjoy nearby biking, such as the cotton valley rail trail(6 mi). We also have an outdoor fire pit to roast marshmallows and enjoy the lake.

Guest access
The entire lake house is yours during your stay. Prior to your arrival, you will receive a unique entry code for the unit front door so no need to worry about losing keys!

Other things to note
THERE ARE PARKING SPACES FOR 4 VEHICLES. THERE IS AN ADDITIONAL FEE FOR EACH ADDITIONAL GUEST BEYOND SIX.

In the winter months AWD vehicles are recommended as it is a gravel road. The road is plowed and sanded after every snow storm.

PLEASE include a few words about you and your guests ~ we love knowing a little about our visitors!

No parties, smoking or animals. Please note, we do not allow any animals. Our son is highly allergic to dander.

Please Read:
DO NOT CONSIDER THIS SITE IF YOU ARE HOSTING A PARTY OR EVENT. GROUPS OF 10 OR MORE ARE NOT ALLOWED. DISRUPTIVE NOISE LEVELS/MUSIC AT ANY TIME OF THE DAY GRAVELY JEOPARDIZE OUR FRIENDLY NEIGHBORHOOD RELATIONSHIPS AND WILL NOT BE TOLERATED. LAW ENFORCEMENT WILL BE CALLED IN & A NEGATIVE REVIEW WILL FOLLOW. WE KINDLY APPRECIATE YOUR CONSIDERATION ~

listing_info.description:

Thoughtfully designed for comfort and connection, enjoy stylish living spaces, a stocked kitchen, coffee bar, large backyard, EV charger, and easy access to town, dining, and year-round adventure.

The space
Welcome to The Morning Glory House, a beautifully designed 4-bedroom retreat in charming Wolfeboro, New Hampshire — just minutes from downtown, Lake Winnipesaukee, and the very best of the Lakes Region.
Thoughtfully curated for comfort, connection, and ease, this warm and elevated home blends modern convenience with the timeless charm of a New England getaway. Whether you're here for lake days, fall foliage, ski weekends, shopping, hiking, or simply time to unwind, The Morning Glory House offers a stay that feels both polished and personal.
Inside, you’ll find inviting living spaces filled with natural light, cozy areas to gather, and quiet corners to relax. The home is designed for both togetherness and comfort, with four beautifully appointed bedrooms, a spacious layout, and thoughtful details throughout.
Guests especially enjoy our fully stocked kitchen, curated coffee and tea bar, soft linens, and the little touches that make the home feel welcoming and easy from the moment you arrive.
Outside, enjoy a large backyard, peaceful morning sunlight, outdoor seating, and space to slow down and savor your time away. We’re also close enough to walk into town, while still offering a sense of privacy and calm once you settle in.
Guest Favorites
4 beautifully appointed bedrooms
Large backyard and outdoor gathering space
Fully stocked kitchen + coffee/tea bar
EV charger (Tesla adapter included)
Minutes to downtown Wolfeboro + Lake Winnipesaukee
Great home base for all four seasons

Whether you're planning a family getaway, a relaxing weekend with friends, or a peaceful New England escape, The Morning Glory House was created to be a place where meaningful memories are made.

During your stay, you’re welcome to enjoy:

Other Things to Note

Additional Amenities:

PERFECT FOR

listing_info.listing_name: Beautiful Historic Home one block to Village
listing_info.description:
Stay at an historic village home on Wolfeboro’s most beloved street. This 4-br, 1.5-bath Colonial home’s large private backyard, idyllic screened porch and historic charm form the perfect place to relax. You’ll be steps to the Wolfeboro Inn, a very short walk to town docks, restaurants, ice cream shops, and all the amenities of “America’s Oldest Summer Resort”. No need to get back in your car but if you want to explore further there are numerous parks, ski resorts, museums, etc.

The space
4 BR, 1.5 BA Just steps from Wolfeboro Village
this 4-br, 1.5-bath colonial home offers a rare opportunity to experience the charm of a New England historic home. Located on a quiet tree lined New Hampshire Street, it’s peaceful flowing outdoor space allows families to enjoy an afternoon wiffle ball game, a family cookout, or quiet retreat with a good book. The location, just steps from the Wolfeboro Inn, town docks and the Abenaki Trails adds to its unique year round vacation features.

The spacious indoor living area includes 4 bedrooms 1.5 baths, a large family dining area just off the easy to navigate kitchen. The comfortable living room has a large screen smart tv, with Wi-Fi speeds for your streaming pleasures. There is a screened in porch, with inviting cozy furnishings, that creates the backdrop of family memories.

I try to leave the home the same way I do for visiting family, all cotton mostly organic bedding, fully stocked kitchen, lots of towels for indoor and out, games, books, guides, throw pillows and blankets. I really want our guests to enjoy their stay and have all the comforts they need.

Wolfeboro Bay, lays comfortably on the shores of New Hampshire’s largest lake, Lake Winnipesaukee. Wolfeboro can honorably boast “America’s Oldest Summer Resort”. The preservation of the small-town charm, allows you to relive your own childhood memories, or create new ones. The season extends well beyond traditional summer vacations. With breathtaking Autumn foliage to enjoy, to cross country ski trails right outside your door. Gunstock Ski area is a brief 20-minute drive away, or the Abenaki ski trails minutes away. and of course, the famous lake ice fishing. Spring bursts into bloom, a wonderful kickstart to the warm summer season.

The house is conveniently located, just a quick walk into the charming village of Wolfeboro, for a wide selection of restaurants, ice cream, sandwich and coffee shops. There is a wonderful variety of stores, along the well-maintained sidewalks, many featuring local artists works. Its convenience enjoyed by guests of the Wolfeboro Inns many events.

The picturesque docks are a few minute walk away where you can board the famed Mt. Washington ship. During the warmer season’s book a sunset dinner, or catch a ride on the mailboat, as it delivers mail to the hundreds of islands that rest lazily on the lake. You can choose to rent a boat (or bring your own) and explore the scenic mountain lined Winnie on your own. This amazing crystal-clear spring fed lake offers swimming, fishing, kayaking, with all levels of experience.

In the basement you will find two bikes, an inflatable paddle board, two kayaks, a lawn bocce set, wiffle ball set and various beach supplies. Please no children in the basement without adult supervision as there are tools and other various dangers.

We love being able to share the area we enjoyed as children. Send me an inquiry if you have any questions about the house and/or area.
We look forward to helping you enjoy this beautiful home and area.

Other things to note
we have a Ring security camera on the front door looking out. No other cameras are at this property.

listing_info.listing_name: Near Beach & Downtwn. Firepit. Ping-Pong. Sauna.
listing_info.description:
Super Location! .5m to beautiful Brewster beach on the shore of Lake Winnipesaukee! Less than 1 mile downtown to cafes, restaurants, kayaking, ice cream, & the famous Wolfeboro rail trail. Antiquing, hiking, shopping, relaxing, the options are limitless! Games for kids, ping pong, chargers, fire pit, EVcharger, fully equipped kitchen, rain shower in one bath & jacuzzi tub in another!

Beautiful 6-8 person cedar barrel sauna, with a window view into the woods, available for use at extra cost.

Other things to note
Turn your stay into a spa retreat with use of our cedar barrel sauna for an additional $150. Breathe in the rejuvenating steam while detoxifying, relieving stress, and improving your skin and immune system. You won’t want to leave and we will be happy to welcome you back!

Please keep in mind - this is a New Hampshire property, where the backyard leads to a wooded area. This means there may be bugs, critters, and animals like bears, deer, racoons, possums, etc.! Sometimes, bugs find their way in the home as well, despite everyone's best efforts to keep them out. Please keep this in mind when choosing our home.

This is a pet free home. If a pet is brought on the property you will immediately be asked to leave and charged a $500 fee.

This is a smoke free home. If you are smoking, you will immediately be asked to leave and charged a fee of $500.

The home has a starter pack of toilet paper, paper towels, trash bags, sponge, soap, etc. We try to be generous with the amount left for each group but it may not last your entire stay, depending on usage. There are many stores in the area where you are able to purchase whatever you may need for your stay beyond what is provided to get you comfortably started.

Guest access
Fishing rods provided

Canoe, kayaks, paddles & life preservers provided

Other things to note
Grew up in New England, spent summers in New Hampshire and later attended college at nearby St. Anselm College in Manchester, NH. Happy now to be able to spend my free time in the Lakes Region and share it with my family & friends!

listing_info.listing_name: Charming home in Wolfeboro
listing_info.description:
Charming 3-bedroom house located in Wolfeboro minutes away from Carry Beach in a quiet and peaceful area but close to everything.
Ideal for a family vacation or just a weekend away with friends.

The space
Charming 4 season home with 3-bedroom 2-bathroom house located in the heart of Wolfeboro. The house is in a quiet neighborhood.
The house has central air.
The house is fully equipped for your convenience, whether you want to relax on the couch and watch a movie or log in to your Netflix and binge a series. Play one of the board games or a little competition on the pool table or the darts board.
You can cook up a great meal in the fully equipped kitchen or on the gas grill outside. Enjoy relaxing in the backyard around the firepit and make memories while making ‘s mores.
The house has 3 bedrooms, 1 King bedroom, 1 Queen bedroom, 1 twin bedroom and 2 queen size sleeper sofas.
There are 3 lounge areas, want to read a book while not being bothered by the noise of a tv or sit in another lounge area and watch your favorite shows or hang out in the basement and watch others play a game of pool, it’s all possible in our house.

Carry Beach is only 0.7 miles away. Brewster Beach is 2 miles away. Albee beach is 4 miles away. 5 Minute drive to downtown Wolfeboro. Wolfeboro Abenaki ski area is 3miles away and Wolfeboro cross country ski is1.5 miles away.

Guest access
Keypad with code

Other things to note
No washer/dryer
No access to the garage

2 cameras facing driveway

Events/parties are not allowed unless approved by owner. Fees will be applied depending on the event.

listing_info.listing_name: 🌟Winni Cottage beach, dock, kayaks, SUP & more! 🌈🍸
listing_info.description:
Great waterfront cottage on Wolfeboro’s Back Bay! Includes 5 kayaks, 2 canoes, a paddleboard & rowboat. 3 bedrooms, plus indoor & outdoor hot showers. Large deck, big grassy lawn, and cozy campfire area.

Calm, protected bay—perfect for beginner paddlers. 40-ft dock, beach area, & swim platform on a mooring. Bring your boat or rent one to access main lake under the bridge.

Just an 8-minute walk to town! Bring bikes explore scenic trails. A peaceful, relaxing retreat with all the lakefront fun.

The space
5 minutes walk to town, I minute by bike! 5 Kayaks, 2 canoes, 2 paddle boards, a paddle boat, sail boat. Small private beach area and swim platform. Located on Back Bay Wolfeboro. Dock for your boat. There is a bridge to go under to Wolfeboro Bay that limits size of boat. Always let us know what boat you intend to bring before booking! Camp fire pit for evening fun. Large grassy fields for outdoor fun!

Guest access
We provide bed linens, comforters, pillows etc, but not towels. Please bring your own! If you are traveling from outside New England area, happy to let you use our personal set. Please ask. You can use everything on property, just take good care of our things. Personal items in basement should not be touched. Don't use the sail boat if you are not a knowledgeable sailer!

Other things to note
We provide all bed linens, comforters and pillows, but please bring your own towels.

We welcome pets with a pet fee. Please add your pet during the reservation process. Please ensure your dog is well behaved, no damage. Please vacuum all your dog's hair around the house and pick up all dog waste from grounds prior to final departure.

Please purchase your own wood for campfire.

Our normal check in time is after 4pm and very rarely is it ready before that time. If it is available earlier we will text you immediately. 😍

listing_info.listing_name: Main House-5 Bed/ 3 Bath-Pet Friendly $50 Fee
listing_info.description:
3 Story 5 Bedroom/3 Bath - Pet Friendly - Victorian Home, built in 1898. Located in Wolfeboro within walking distance to Lake Winnipesaukee, the shops and restaurants.

We provide free beach passes to the town beaches including Brewster, Carry, & Albee Beach at no charge, kayaks, paddleboards, & bicycles for guests to use in common.

Max 15 Adults / 19 People. Pet friendly - Limit 1 - $50 fee applies. Pet must be registered at the time of booking.. No unregistered pets welcome.

The space
The Main House - Stand Alone Home Newly renovated! (Open Year Round). This three story home features 5 bedrooms, and 3 bathrooms. We decorate for Halloween! See pictures!

First Floor: 1 Bedroom and full bath with Queen Sized Bed, Second Floor: 3 Bedrooms with full bath. Master has a King Bed with electric fireplace, 2nd bedroom has Queen, and 3rd room has 2 Queens, Third Floor: 1 Large open Bedroom and game room with 5 single beds, four chairs convertible to twin (suitable for children), and a full bath. The home sleeps 15 adults or a total of 19 people comfortably. There is a Roku smart television in the living room, master bedroom and 1st floor Queen bedroom, and we provide free high speed WIFI throughout the property.

The Main house includes private decks and a private courtyard complete with a gas grill, Adirondack chairs, and a chiminea. In the common area courtyards we feature: family friendly outdoor games like corn hole, tetherball, 2 fire pits, Adirondack chairs, a hammock, multiple flower gardens, an arch, a pagoda, and two gas grills. We offer beach passes, free kayaks, paddleboards, and bicycles for guests to use in common during your stay. We can even transport them! Ask your host for details! There are walking trails behind the property and the Wolfeboro town docks are just two blocks up on Main Street from the property.

The home is within walking distance to all of the Main St, Wolfeboro attractions including restaurants, shops, breweries, beaches, the town docks, public parks etc. In the summer the community offers multiple free events including an outdoor concert series.

We do not have an office so you will proceed directly to the Main House entrance when you arrive.

Pet friendly $50 Fee applies. Limit 1. No unregistered pets welcome

Guest access
We will provide a code to the door a few days prior to your arrival. Note the renters agreement must be completed prior to the access code being provided.

If you have not completed the renters agreement as of the day of arrival you may only check in up to 8 p.m. and only after they are completed. We recommend completing it as soon as booking so that you are free to check in at any time that is convenient for you after 4 pm on the day of arrival.

Other things to note
We provide a Nespresso machine, Keurig Duo and coffee to get you started, Kitchen-Aid mixer, air fryer, firewood for the fire pits, gas for the dedicated gas grill, and all the basics for cooking.

listing_info.listing_name: Win-win! Relax at our place & play at the lake!
listing_info.description:
Great location! Completely updated 3 BR, 1 BA across the street from the Cotton Valley Rail Trail and Crescent Lake/Mast Landing. Ride your bike 1 mile to town or 1 mile to Albee Beach or go for a challenge and ride the whole 26 miles round trip! Bring your boat or kayak and launch it across the street. After a long day at the lake, enjoy an evening on the outdoor sectional and light a fire!

Property sleeps 6 people in beds (up to 8 with air mattress).

The space
Two outdoor seating areas (seasonal availability). Propane gas grill and propane fire pit available for use.

Guest access
Parking available for up to 3 cars. Garage available for motorcycle use only during bike week in June.

listing_info.listing_name: Cozy Basin House in Wolfeboro, NH
listing_info.description:
This home holds a special place in our heart. It belonged to a wonderful person who treasured the beauty of Wolfeboro, and the peacefulness that this house provides. Tucked into Fernald's basin, adjacent to Lake Wentworth in Wolfeboro, New Hampshire, this is a true retreat. Perfect for a family or a small group to get together and enjoy all that Wolfeboro has to offer. Water views and access, close to downtown, and plenty of space to relax, we hope you'll enjoy this home as much as we do.

The space
There are two bedrooms and 2 full baths on the upper level as well as the kitchen, dining and a living area. The basement has a family room with tv and the bunkroom. There is a slider that opens to the deck and back yard.

Other things to note
The Basin is shallow, the water is clean, bottom is not sandy. The basin is enclosed and not “ beachy”. Perfect for paddleboards and kayaks. Great for fishing.
The house is also on a well traveled road and in the summer with the increased number of people in the area there can be some traffic noise.

listing_info.listing_name: South of the border
listing_info.description:
One of two relaxing refurbished cabins located on Goodwin's basin. You can watch the turtles right from the comforts of the livingroom. Located right off of the Bridge Falls Path, making it convenient for biking or walking to town. Quiet clean beach located on Crescent Lake for you to enjoy with the kids, and access to a boat dock upon booking.

The space
If needing to house larger groups rent both cabins to obtain room for 12 people. The loft is adequate for children, but not toddlers.

listing_info.listing_name: Downtown Wolfeboro Luxe | Walk to Shops & Docks
listing_info.description:
Back Bay Loft – Luxury Lakeview Condo, you will not want to leave this place, guaranteed! Spacious, high-end 3BR condo in the heart of Wolfeboro! Sleeps families in style with open-concept living, gourmet kitchen, games, smart TVs, popcorn & gumball machines, and kids’ loft. Steps to town docks, dining, shops. Historic Colonial Arms building with cathedral ceilings, plush linens, and bay views. 2 parking spots + overflow.

The space
Welcome to your dream retreat in the heart of Wolfeboro—the oldest resort town in America 🇺🇸. This expansive, fully renovated Main Street condo blends modern luxury with small-town charm in the iconic Colonial Arms building. Originally built in 1900, this is one of Wolfeboro’s historic landmark buildings—now thoughtfully updated with high-end modern finishes throughout while preserving its timeless character.

Inside, you'll find 2 oversized bedrooms plus a whimsical kids' reading room filled with cozy bean bag chairs, a chalkboard wall, books, and games galore. The open-concept layout includes two spacious living room areas, a massive dining table perfect for family meals or board games, and a stunning electric fireplace to gather around.

Love to entertain? You’ll adore the fully stocked kitchen, complete with a popcorn machine, gumball machine, and modern appliances. Kick back with your favorite shows on smart TVs throughout or relax outside on the cozy porch downstairs —perfect for people-watching!

Enjoy serene views of Back Bay, walk to the town docks, top-rated restaurants, and boutique shops. This is a quiet building in the heart of it all.
Sleeping Arrangements
Bedroom 1: 1 King bed
Bedroom 2: 1 King bed
Loft: 1 Full bed, 2 Twin beds, and 2 Twin floor mattresses (additional sleeping space)

Other Highlights:

Plush, high-end linens & bedding
Master suite with a walk-in tiled shower
Dedicated workspace
2 assigned parking spots + overflow parking
Portable grill for outdoor cooking

Whether you're here for a lake escape, a fun family getaway, or a relaxing New England vacation, this one-of-a-kind condo offers the perfect place to make unforgettable memories.

Guest access
Guest Access
Guests will have full access to the entire 2,692 sq ft condo, including all living spaces, bedrooms, and amenities — it’s all yours to enjoy during your stay!

Beach passes for Wolfeboro beaches: Carry Beach & Albee Beach.

Please note: this is a shared building, and our lovely neighbor across the hall is visually impaired. We kindly ask that you keep noise to a minimum and be especially mindful in the shared stairwell and entry area.

Nothing may be left or stored between the parking spaces and the direct entrance to the condo, especially in or near the stairwell, as it must remain clear at all times for safety and accessibility.

You’ll have 2 assigned parking spaces, and there is often overflow parking available next door on a first-come, first-served basis.

As much as we love pups, this property is NOT dog-friendly as they are not allowed by the association in the building.

Please note: The condo is on the second and third floors of the building. Guests will need to climb one flight of stairs to reach the condo entrance, and once inside, there is another short flight of stairs to access the upper level of the condo. This property is not wheelchair accessible.

Other things to note
This condo is located in a shared, quiet historic building — please be respectful of neighbors
• A visually impaired neighbor lives across the hall; keep noise low and hallways clear
• No items may be stored in common areas, stairwells, or near the entrance at any time
• No pets allowed — the building association does not permit animals
• Two assigned parking spaces are provided; overflow parking may be available next door
• Beach passes are included for Carry Beach and Albee Beach
• Portable grill available for outdoor cooking
• Quiet hours are observed in the building

✅ Good News! Your stay includes coverage for accidental damage and mishaps. We take your safety and security seriously, and this property has special local compliance requirements of a signed rental agreement and ID verification. To make this easy for you, we use a secure and very simple, app-free platform called Happy Guest. It is not an app, and you do not have to sign up for an account — it’s a safe and secure website. It also gives you a guest portal with all the info about the home and all of my favorite local spots.

listing_info.listing_name: Crescent Lake Family Escape
listing_info.description:
This spacious retreat offers 7 bedrooms and accommodates 16 plus, making it ideal for family reunions or group vacations. Enjoy a bright living area, a fully equipped kitchen, and a cozy dining space. The beautiful backyard and deck provide stunning views of Crescent Lake.
Just steps from the beach, enjoy swimming and kayaking. Explore downtown Wolfeboro, or venture into nature for hiking and biking. With free Wi-Fi and ample parking, our home is your perfect getaway year-round!

The space
A long private driveway leads you into area of ample parking. The home is situated on 3 acres, wooded. lots of green space, a shallow entry beach to Crescent Lake in the backyard, a large patio with plenty of seating, a gas grill, and a wood fired pizza oven. The interior has 2 floors. The first floor has 4 bedrooms, and 2 bathrooms, a large living area and kitchen and dining room. The basement has 3 bedrooms, a pool table room, and a living area with a home bar area. Above the garage we have a dormitory style 5 bed sleeping area with each pod having a twin bed, phone charging station, and storage area for each bed. With a living area with tv and overstuffed bean bag chairs.

Guest access
Guests have full access to the house except for an owners closet upstairs that is locked. The utility room in the basement will be locked as well. Power boats are not for guest use as well.

Other things to note
We provide some basic items to get you started, but will need to be replenished by the guest
Paper towels, toilet paper, paper goods, detergents, soaps
Camping/fire wood needs to be provided by the guest
Propane is provided for the grills.
2 5 gallon spring water jugs are provided for the guest to use with our water cooler.
Basement is not controlled by Centrail Air, but maintains a constant low temp due to foundation being under ground. Fans are available for guest use as well

listing_info.listing_name: King’s Cottage PERFECTLY LOCATED!
listing_info.description:
The Cottage offers the perfect getaway for couples or small family. First floor living with 2 additional bedrooms upstairs, plus tween/teen lounge area & kids corner.
The cottage is on a quiet street, but walkable to coffee, restaurants, and downtown shopping. Great proximity to Lake Winni, Sewall Woods, Cottonwood Rail Trail.

It's an easy 1 hr drive from Manchester airport or 2 hr from Boston.

The space
Welcome to our cottage get away, where our family enjoys slowing down life to pause for a moment. We would love to share it with you and hope you enjoy it and the charming town as much as we do!

MUD ROOM:
A perfect place to hang up your coats and leave your shoes before making yourself at home. *Note the cottage is a shoe free home.

THE KITCHEN:
It is well equipped with all the basics you need for home cooked meals: gas stove, microwave, full size fridge, dishwasher, dishes, glassware and cookware. You will also find: drop coffee marker, electric kettle, toaster, instant pot, and blender.

LIVING ROOM:
The open-concept kitchen/dining area/living room on the main floor is a great space for families or small groups to gather. The living room has a wingback arm chair & full size couch, TV with Chromcast to stream all your favorite movies, and high-speed WiFi (400MBPS). You will also find board games, books & puzzles. In the summer months a window AC unit is installed.

DINING:
Our dining table accommodates up to 6 people with the extra chair stored in the master closet.

BEDROOMS:
#1 -- on the main living level, near the bathroom; it has a California king bed, a bench, 2 nightstands, a dresser, portable fan, window AC unit for summer months, & large closet.

#2 -- on the upper level of the house; it has a full bed, pop-up desk, 1 nightstand, luggage stand, portable fan, & closet.

#3 -- also on the upper level of the house; it has a queen bed, 1 nightstand, luggage stand, portable fan, a closet & dresser.

(Please see the note below regarding the upstairs AC)

UPSTAIRS OPEN SPACE:
In the open landing area upstairs we have created an additional living space ideal for tweens / teens alike. On the opposite side is the kids corner with a small table and chairs, books, toys, games, and more.

*NOTE for summer guest: this space has a window AC unit. For the upstairs bedrooms to benefit from the cool air it's suggested to leave the doors open.

EXTERIOR SURROUNDINGS:
The cottage comfortably distanced between 2 neighbors with no neighbor directly in front. There is a small front and backyard. The backyard does open up to a larger open space and small wooded area.

PARKING:
The driveway has space for up to 4 vehicles, or less vehicles and a boat trailer if you'd like to bring yours.

Other things to note
-A beach pass is provide from Memorial Day - Labor Day for access to Carry & Albee Beach.

-Kids of all ages are welcome at your discretion, but the house does have a staircase, and gas stove in the kitchen.

-There is one exterior security camera; facing the driveway/road located in the middle of the garage. This is primarily to ensure property maintenance is taken care of, and also double as a security measure for our liability.

listing_info.listing_name: Cottage 8-9 - Year Round - Pet Friendly $50 Fee- S
listing_info.description:
Cottage 8-9-2 bedroom & 2 bath w/ large courtyard. Bedroom 1: Queen Bed & Twin Daybed plus private restroom with tub/shower. Bedroom 2: 2 Queen Beds plus a loft suitable for children, accessible by ladder with two Twins and private restroom with tub/shower. There is a private courtyard complete with Adirondack chairs, a charcoal grill (charcoal provided),chiminea, a hammock, a swing, and a picnic table.

Max-7 Adults / 2 children /1 Pet (fee applies).

The space
Three Season Double End Unit 2 Bedroom / 2 Bathroom Cottage

Guest access
We will provide a code to the door a few days prior to your arrival. Note the renters agreement must be completed prior to the access code being provided.

If you have not completed the renters agreement as of the day of arrival you may only check in up to 8 p.m. and only after it is completed. We recommend completing it as soon as booking so that you are free to check in at any time that is convenient for you after 4 pm on the day of arrival.

Other things to note
We provide the following amenities free of charge for our guests: Beach passes, charcoal, two gas grills in common, firewood for the firepits, coffee pouches, linens, paper goods, kayaks, bicycles, board games, basic spices, and basic toiletries. Our common areas have all you need to relax or enjoy your family and friends. We have hammocks, two fire pits, tetherball, games (like cornhole), Adirondack chairs, flower gardens, and picnic tables for the guests to enjoy.

listing_info.listing_name: Lakefront Home Recently Built - Prime Spot
listing_info.description:
Just 5 minutes from downtown Wolfeboro, NH, this beautifully newly built waterfront retreat is designed for comfort and connection. With 2 spacious living rooms, 2 fully equipped kitchens, 4 bathrooms, and 10 beds, it’s perfect for families or large groups. Enjoy a private dock, expansive deck with scenic views, sandy beach, fire pit, and a fun tire swing—plus complimentary kayaks and paddleboards for unforgettable days on the water.

The space
Property Layout

Welcome in—this newly constructed home is thoughtfully spread across three levels for both comfort and convenience. The main level, where you enter from the street, makes arrivals easy and seamless. Head downstairs to the walk-out lower level, where you’ll find direct access to the beach, dock, and lake—perfect for stepping right into your waterfront experience. Upstairs, the upper level offers beautiful views of the property and an open overlook into the main living area below.

A Quick Note

As a brand-new home, we’re still putting the finishing touches in place. You may notice a few minor details like paint touch-ups being completed, but everything is fully functional and ready for you to enjoy your stay.

Guest access
Enjoy full access to the entire property and private waterfront during your stay. The 30ft dock is perfect for relaxing, swimming, or launching a day on the lake. While we do not provide a motorized boat, guests are welcome to bring their own or rent one locally—there will be dedicated space available along the dock for your convenience.

listing_info.listing_name: Cottage 1-2 - Pet Friendly $50 Fee-2 Bed / 1 Bath
listing_info.description:
Features two bedrooms - Bedroom 1 - one Queen bed w/ children's loft accessible by ladder with 2 Twins - Bedroom 2 - one Double bed, and two Single trundle beds. The cottage also includes an inviting electric fireplace and one full bathroom with a shower.

Private courtyard w/ Adirondack chairs, a picnic table, charcoal grill (charcoal provided), and a chiminea with complimentary firewood—perfect for relaxing after a day on the lake.

Max 6 adults / 2 Children / 1 Pet (must be registered)

The space
**Cottage 1-2 | Double End Unit** We decorate for Halloween! See pictures!

Cottage 1-2 is a spacious double end unit conveniently located closest to our entrance and Main Street, offering easy access to all that downtown Wolfeboro has to offer.

This cottage features two bedrooms - Bedroom 1 - one Queen bed w/ children's loft accessible by ladder with 2 Twins - Bedroom 2 - one Double bed, and two Single trundle beds. The cottage also includes an inviting electric fireplace and one full bathroom with a shower.
Step outside to your own **private courtyard**, complete with Adirondack chairs, a picnic table, charcoal grill (charcoal provided), and a chiminea with complimentary firewood—perfect for relaxing after a day on the lake.

**Maximum Occupancy:** 6 Adults + 2 Children (using the loft). Pet friendly $50 Fee applies. Pet must be registered at the time of booking. No unregistered pets allowed!

### Included Guest Amenities

* Beach passes
* Kayaks
* Paddleboards
* Bicycles

### Kitchenette Features

The fully equipped kitchenette includes:
* Stove and oven
* Refrigerator
* Microwave
* Toaster
* Keurig Duo coffee maker
* Basic cookware, utensils, plates, cups, and kitchen essentials

### Pet-Friendly Accommodations

We welcome registered pets. A **$50 fee per pet** applies. Must be registered with the guests when you book!

### Prime Wolfeboro Location

Enjoy being within walking distance of:
* Lake Winnipesaukee
* Town docks and public boat launch
* Downtown Wolfeboro shops, restaurants, and attractions

Just two doors away is **Foss Field**, located along Back Bay on Lake Winnipesaukee, featuring:
* Pickleball courts
* Basketball courts
* Playground
* Expansive grassy recreation area

In the opposite direction, you'll find the entrance to the scenic **Cotton Valley Rail Trail**, a beautiful walking and biking path that connects directly to downtown Wolfeboro via Railroad Avenue.

Whether you're visiting for a family vacation, lake adventure, wedding weekend, or relaxing getaway, Cottage 1-2 offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and New Hampshire lake-town charm.

Guest access
We will provide a code to the door a few days prior to your arrival. Note the renters agreement must be completed prior to the access code being provided. If you have not completed the renters agreement prior to the day of arrival you must check in prior to 8 p.m. and only after completing it. We recommend completing it upon booking so that you can check in any time after 4 p.m. that is convenient for you.

Other things to note
We provide the following amenities free of charge for our guests: beach passes, charcoal, two gas grills in common, firewood for the fire pits, coffee starter packs, linens, paper goods, kayaks, bicycles, board games, basic spices, and basic toiletries. Our common areas have all you need to relax or enjoy your family and friends. We have hammocks, two fire pits, tetherball, games (like cornhole), Adirondack chairs, flower gardens, and picnic tables for the guests to enjoy. This unit also features an electric fireplace in bedroom 1.
